settings.title: Application Settings
settings.subtitle: Tune the map, tracking, alerts, and diagnostics from one quiet control surface.
settings.themeDetail: Display mode for map controls and panels.
settings.unitsDetail: Distance, speed, altitude, and route summaries.
settings.precisionModeDetail: Use tighter GPS sampling when navigation is active.
settings.offlineModeDetail: Keep recent routes and map data available during weak signal.
settings.safetyAlertsDetail: Notify when routes, zones, or device status need attention.
settings.reducedMotionDetail: Lower panel animation and visual motion across the app.
settings.debugModeDetail: Show diagnostics, logs, and engine status while testing.
